verdict.rationale: Zep documents thread summaries as natural-language summaries of a thread's messages that Zep itself generates and incrementally updates. Its auto-scope search can fold those summaries into a ready-to-use context block for an agent, and the creator's description of Zep as conversation-history memory with summaries independently corroborates this. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the endpoint for fetching a specific past thread's summary, hands-on confirmation that an agent can resume a prior session from that summary.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.
let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block
